name.zh: 留住商品等下一轮再买
name.en: Reserve a shop item for a later purchase

summary.zh: 暂时买不起，也可以先保住这次机会。
summary.en: Keep a useful offer even when you cannot afford it yet.

rules.zh: 玩家标记商店中的某个物品，使它在刷新或下一轮补货时保留，未保留的格子继续更新。保留能等待资金或组合条件，却占掉发现新商品的位置；解除保留会重新开放这个位置。
rules.en: Mark an offer to persist through rerolls or restocking while unmarked slots refresh. Reservation buys time for money or a combination, but occupies space that could reveal new options. Releasing it restores that slot.

loop.zh: 找到暂时无法购买的目标
loop.en: Find an offer you cannot use yet

loop.zh: 标记保留并刷新其他格
loop.en: Reserve it and refresh other slots
Gain resources or revise your needs
Buy it or release the slot

decisions.zh: 为未来组合保留一件，会不会错过本轮更实用的新货？
decisions.en: Will reserving a future combo piece hide more useful immediate offers?

decisions.zh: 资金够了，但需求已经变化，是否承认沉没成本并放弃？
decisions.en: Once you can afford it, should changed needs make you release it anyway?

effect.zh: 格数多降低错失焦虑，格数少让信息空间成为真实成本。
effect.en: More reserved slots reduce fear of missing out; fewer make shop space costly.

effect.zh: 只跨一次刷新适合轻决策，跨回合保留鼓励更长计划。
effect.en: One-reroll persistence supports short choices; multi-round persistence supports longer plans.

contrast.zh: 背包乱斗还要考虑物品能否装进背包；超级自动宠物主要考虑宠物队伍、升级与食物用途。
contrast.en: Backpack Battles adds physical inventory fit; Super Auto Pets emphasizes the team, pet upgrades and food effects.

combination.zh: 组合提案：保留一件异形装备后，玩家在下一轮腾挪背包为它留空；若腾出的空间代价太高，可以取消预留改买小件。
combination.en: Design proposal: reserving an oddly shaped item creates a packing goal for the next round, with the option to release it when making room costs too much.

setup.zh: 商店有一把六币大剑，你只有四币，下一轮能多拿三币。
setup.en: A six-coin sword appears while you have four coins and expect three next round.

action.zh: 保留大剑，只刷新其他格子。
action.en: Reserve the sword and reroll only the other slots.

result.zh: 大剑仍在，但少一个格子展示新物品。
result.en: The sword remains, but one fewer slot reveals new items.

next.zh: 下轮钱够了，再比较买剑与解除保留找其他装备。
next.en: Next round, compare buying the sword with releasing it to seek alternatives.

firstStep.zh: 四格商店、刷新按钮、金币和保留标记，先做两轮即可。
firstStep.en: Build a four-slot shop, reroll button, coins and reservation markers across two rounds.

pitfall.zh: 保留和购买必须有明确区分，避免误以为已经拥有物品。

test.zh: 玩家是否会主动解除不再需要的保留，而非永远占着格子？
test.en: Do players release obsolete reservations rather than hold every slot forever?
